The '''''Victrix''''' was a [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] serving the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was deployed to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Demophon]] to assist in the evacuation of the planet prior to the [[Demophon supernova]].
